doc: One record per program the scanned scripts invoke (farm/script_programs.py): leaf = starts no other program; runner = starts the program named by its argv (the rule says where: kind argv = after `skip` positionals and the options, optarg lists options that take a value; kind flag = after one of the flags; kind string = the literal after the flag is shell text, parsed again); opaque = starts programs named in data files (makefiles, python code): they are the profile's `prerequisites`, verified by the exec log. A scanned program without a record is red (script_programs.py, envcheck scripts). `package` is the Ubuntu package whose documentation `doc` cites (it must be a package of a build profile).
